verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API for performing console actions without the web UI, plus an HTTP API for evaluating gates and configs and logging events without an SDK. Together these let the product be operated headlessly from scripts. Nothing in the evidence specifically covers CI usage, such as a CLI, GitHub Action or CI integration guide, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration (CLI or CI actions), machine-readable API spec, hands-on corroboration of headless automation workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
Overview of the Statsig HTTP API for retrieving feature gate, experiment, and dynamic config values and logging events directly without an SDK.
